name: friday-mcp
description: Talk to the Friday Obsidian plugin from Claude: list/edit tasks, manage sprint topics, query daily plan.
long_description: A thin stdio→HTTP bridge to the MCP server embedded in the Friday Obsidian plugin. Forwards JSON-RPC tool calls from Claude Desktop to the plugin's localhost server, which performs the actual vault reads/writes via the plugin's service layer. Obsidian must be running with the Friday plugin loaded and its MCP server enabled.

host.title: Plugin host
host.description: Where the Friday plugin's MCP server is listening. Leave as 127.0.0.1 unless you reconfigured it to bind elsewhere.

port.title: Plugin port
port.description: The port set in Friday's Settings → MCP Server. Default 27225.

token.title: Bearer token
token.description: Copy from Friday's Settings → MCP Server → Bearer token. Required on every request.
